about.title: About Central do Grid
about.p1: Central do Grid started as a personal project, created as a hobby and also as a way to test different tools and development ideas.
about.p2: Taking advantage of a free day, I started the project from scratch and, over the following days, kept improving and refining it until I reached a result I felt satisfied with, both visually and functionally.
about.p3: At the moment, the site is still in a basic stage. It does not use APIs or a database yet, relying on manually organized data. Even so, the focus has been to create a simple, clear, and well-structured experience for following Formula 1.
about.p4: The plan is to keep evolving the project over time, adding new features, API integrations, and overall improvements.
about.creditsText: Central do Grid is an independent fan-made project. Formula 1, F1, and team names are property of their respective owners.
